attribution.title: Foam — Fodor Museum canal houses
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free reconstruction of precisely scoped historic canal museum buildings using actual OpenStreetMap/current BAG geometry and official museum/architect exterior photographs. Original window, gable, doorcase and stair geometry; rear courtyard/lightwell rings and the OnsSolder public alley preserved. Foam light courts represented with low glass covers as described by its architect. Dimensions and ornament approximate.
